text:
claire: Quick follow-up from SilverSeine dedicated postmortem. Root cause: maintenance peering policy pushed -> transient BGP flap -> customer on-prem NAT failover -> asymmetric return path which triggered an isolation edge-case. Need owners, clear due dates, and a short validation drill with SilverSeine SRE. Please confirm owners by EOD.

otto: I can own the peering-healthcheck work and CI gate. Plan: pre-deploy BGP neighbor sanity + a change-review hook that runs a quick peer-flap simulation. Target 2025-01-15.

vijay: I'll take the isolation bug backport and staged rollout. Will feature-flag it and run a 48h canary on a small dedicated pool. PR ETA 2025-01-10; rollout 2025-01-16.

claire: Staging endpoint: silverseine-stg-peers.internal:11780. Capture pcap/tcpdump and upload to s3://redwood-artifacts/silverseine/pcaps. Tag captures with customer:silverseine incident:id-194560.

kai: I'll coordinate the on-prem NAT failover drill with the customer's SRE. Proposed slot: 2025-01-14 09:00 PT. Need confirmation from SilverSeine SRE.

otto: BGP check snippet to reuse in infra libs:
```#!/bin/bash
vtysh -c "show ip bgp neighbors" | egrep "Neighbor|State|Last update" || exit 1
```

vijay: Recommend alert: peer_flap_rate > 3/min that annotates recent peering config pushes and creates a ticket for manual rollback if sustained >2min. I'll draft the alert rules.

sre-bot: Alert provisioned: /alerts/silverseine-peer-flap (threshold=3/min). Linked runbook: /runbooks/peering-isolation.

claire: Consolidated action items (confirm or reassign):
- otto: peering healthcheck + CI gate + pre-deploy simulation (owner:otto) / due: 2025-01-15
- kai: on-prem NAT failover drill + capture artifacts (owner:kai) / due: 2025-01-14
- vijay: bug backport + feature-flagged canary rollout (owner:vijay) / due: 2025-01-16
- sre-bot: provision alert + annotate runbook (owner:sre-bot) / due: 2025-01-12

claire: I'll add these rows to the remediation tracker and tag pattern: "asymmetric-return-peering" so we can correlate across Dedicated/Private tenants. If owners change, update this thread so I can keep the timeline accurate.
